instruction: Fix intervals.py. merge receives half-open intervals (start,end). Return a sorted list of merged strictly overlapping nonempty intervals as tuples. Adjacent intervals must stay separate; drop zero-length intervals; reject start>end with ValueError; do not mutate the input list. covered returns the total length of their union using merge. Run `python3 test_intervals.py`; do not edit tests. The solution must support arbitrary valid inputs, including nesting, duplicates, negative coordinates and empty input. Return DONE after verification. Work only inside the current directory.
